metadata.title: Endomorphisms of Total Kneser Graphs
metadata.abstract: Inspired by work of Gaster, Greene, and Vlamis on the chromatic number of curve graphs, we prove that every endomorphism of the total Kneser graph is an automorphism. We also show that the automorphism group of the total Kneser graph is the product of a pair of permutation groups.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: total Kneser 图的自同态刚性
analysis.workSummary: 证明 total Kneser 图的每个 endomorphism 都是 automorphism，并确定其 automorphism 群是两个置换群的乘积。
analysis.breakthrough: 把与曲线图着色有关的组合对象的自映射全部刚化。
analysis.limitations: 研究对象是 total Kneser 图，结论不能直接推广到任意有限 Kneser 图或曲线图。
